title: IPTV Troubleshooting: Fix Buffering and Freezing
description: How to diagnose IPTV buffering and freezing in a set order: wired test, other apps, DNS, player buffer and decoder settings, then the source.
intro: Buffering can start in three places: the network, the device and player, or the source. The guide here walks through tests in order, so you change one thing at a time and find the layer that is actually failing.

faq.question: Why does IPTV buffer even on fast broadband?
faq.answer: A speed test is a short burst to a nearby server. Wi-Fi, the player buffer, DNS and the source server can each cause stalls even when a speed test looks fine. The buffering guide tests them one at a time.
